keyVerseDR: "Be glad and rejoice for your reward is very great in heaven." (Mt 5:12)

level1.title: God's Holy Friends
level1.story: Jesus taught on a mountain. He said, "Blessed are the poor in spirit, the merciful, and the peacemakers." The saints lived this way. We can be saints too!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you become a saint?
level1.prayer: All holy saints, pray for us. Amen.

activity.title: Guess the saint
activity.intro: Read the clues. Who is it?
clues: I was a young French nun.
I loved Jesus by doing little things with great love.
I am called the Little Flower.

level2.title: The Beatitudes and the Saints
level2.story: Seeing the crowds, Jesus went up a mountain and taught them. "Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven." Blessed are the meek, those who mourn, and those who hunger and thirst after justice. "Blessed are the merciful... Blessed are the clean of heart... Blessed are the peacemakers." Jesus said, "Be glad and rejoice, for your reward is very great in heaven."
level2.keyLine: Be glad and rejoice for your reward is very great in heaven.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Which Beatitude will you live this week?
level2.prayer: All you holy men and women, pray for us. Amen.

activity.title: The saint I want to be like
activity.intro: All Saints' Day! Write about a saint you admire.
starters: This saint lived the Beatitudes by...
